title: GENESIS: Gene-Specific Machine Learning Models for Variants of Uncertain Significance Found in Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia and Long QT Syndrome-Associated Genes
summary: Gene-specific logistic-regression and MLP models were trained with 10-fold cross-validation on curated pathogenic and benign variants for RYR2, KCNQ1, KCNH2 and SCN5A, then applied to ClinVar and exome variants of uncertain significance. The paper reports model comparisons, blinded KCNQ1 patch-clamp tests including a discordant V106D prediction, prospective family cosegregation for G245R and V241I, and blinded retrospective clinical correlation in 9 of 10 cases. This is a channelopathy variant-interpretation finding, not a prospective clinical utility trial.
